findings.text: Upheld, defect (Q2, logic duplicated). The CLI's `policyInForce` (load, return if closed, `reconcileSettings`, `reconcileLevels`, load again) is the same five-step sequence as `policyInForce` in src/ui/api.ts:916. The CLI's `requireLoaded` (share.ts:123) builds the same refusal text as `sharingRefusal` (src/ui/api.ts:906). I read both in the tree. This is a rule, not boilerplate, and ADR 0025 asks part 6 to run it too. Export it once from src/sharing/.

Upheld, defect (Q4, dead path). The `catch` in the new `sharing` check cannot be reached. `loadPolicy` (src/sharing/policy.ts:275) wraps `readPolicy` in its own try and returns a closed policy. `logError` (src/util/log.ts:21) swallows its own failures. `isDefault`, `projectsAt`, `shareListText` and `plural` are pure. The docstring's reason for the try (sharing tables missing) is already handled inside `loadPolicy`.
Advisory, as filed. `_now` is a parameter no step reads. The codebase has the same pattern elsewhere (Q4/Q5).
Advisory, as filed. Only tests call `previewLevel`, while ADR 0025 describes it as the check every path makes. The record and the code disagree (Q8).
Advisory, as filed. `LEVELS.indexOf` comparison repeats `widens`, which ui/src/api.ts already re-exports (Q2, one line).
Advisory, as filed. `export { memoryHash }` is an unused re-export (Q8; the rubric rates an unused export advisory).
Advisory, as filed. `policyWith` and `resetSharingLog` are test hooks in production modules (Q8).
Advisory, as filed. `tableExists` duplicates the `sqlite_master` lookup of `hasLevelsTable` (Q2, boilerplate).
Advisory, as filed. `rootOf` writes out the root rule that `entryRefusal` also writes inline at src/sharing/policy.ts:332 (Q2, a one-line rule).
Advisory, as filed. The sharing key names are declared in several places, while settings.ts keeps its own private (Q2, boilerplate).
Advisory, as filed. The comment on `removed` suggests an effect the Remove button does not have: every save drops inert ids anyway (Q3/Q10).

Advisory, as filed. `projectsAt` here returns a count. `projectsAt` in src/sharing/report.ts:295 returns ids. One name has two meanings (Q3, a name that could be sharper, not the opposite of what it does).
Advisory, as filed. `confirm` is now a one-line forwarder to `askYesNo` (Q5).

Upheld, defect (Q1). AC-15 as recorded in work.json:92 promises "NEVER_LEAVES equals the design's list". No such constant exists and no test asserts it, so the recorded clause has no test that fails on reversion. It stands until the session supersedes AC-15 with the spec's later text (spec.md:343). No test is needed once the criterion is amended.

Upheld, defect (Q1). AC-5 as recorded (work.json:42) says "with a sent record of another version, send". The test at this line pins the reverse (keep, already-sent, whatever the version), and the code decides by hash only. No test can fail for the recorded clause. It stands until AC-5 is superseded by the spec's text (spec.md:333).

Upheld, defect (Q4, an observed reason that is false). AC-14's recorded reason is that no red run can exist for prose. Its own command, `grep -c '^| D-'` on the ADR, would have failed before the ADR existed. That command also checks only the D-rows. It leaves out the README Sharing subsection and the CLAUDE.md bullet the criterion promises.

Advisory, as filed. AC-7's recorded text ('one query that excludes user_memories') drifts from the tests and the spec. The count a caller sees is tested and fails on reversion. Amend the recorded text.
Advisory, as filed. AC-6's recorded 'does nothing with no row' is stale against spec.md:334 and AC-12. The test is right.
Advisory, as filed. No assertion checks that the warning names `WIZARDINGCODE_MEM_SHARE_AREAS` (Q6/Q1, partial).
Advisory, as filed. The CLI cases for `share roots`/`share areas --yes` do not assert the counter or epoch bump. The bump is proven one layer down.
Advisory, as filed. No test pins install's `confirm` default of yes through `askYesNo`. I may not raise the reviewer's severity.
Advisory, as filed. The new case and the rename are additive and weaken no preserved assertion. The letter of AC-13 ('nothing else in it changes') is not met. Amend the criterion or move the case.

Upheld, defect (Q1 boundary, personal-data). The new sharing guard looks only at the keys of `validated.changes`. The probe probes/newline-in-a-setting.md shows a token holder can still widen sharing: they send `PUT /api/settings` with no `confirm` and a newline in `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` or `WIZARDINGCODE_MEM_BACKUP_S3_REGION`. The env file then gains a `WIZARDINGCODE_MEM_SHARE_ROOTS=workspace,shared` line, and both roots are in force. There is no confirmation and no `viewer` change row. Correction to the example: the reviewer's `WIZARDINGCODE_MEM_AUTHOR` is refused (its rule says 'on one line'); the defect holds through the other keys. Fix it where values enter: `validatePatch` refuses `\r` and `\n` in every value.

Upheld, defect (personal-data). `setLevel` binds any `remote:` alias. For an origin that is a local path or a `file://` URL, `normalizeRemote` (src/core/git.ts:137, :149) returns the path itself, so the binding stores something like `remote:/Users/<name>/...`. This item pins that alias into `OutgoingEntry.remoteAlias`, `OutgoingMemory.remoteAlias` and the entry uid. ADR 0025:134 lists `path:` aliases under 'Never'. Nothing is sent in this part, but the stored binding and the pinned contract are this item's. Accept only a host-led remote alias; answer `no-remote` otherwise.
Advisory, as filed. `confirm: true` is hard-coded after an earlier preview, which leaves a race window. This is hardening.
Advisory, as filed. An inert area id comes into force with no confirmation when the area is later added to the taxonomy. The epoch moves. The line is a patch line, as the reviewer notes.
Advisory, as filed. A restore done by the 0.6.0 rollback binary or by hand keeps the copy's levels. The ADR does not say so.
Advisory, as filed. 'The environment never widens' holds per data directory only. The boundary paragraph should say so.
Advisory, as filed. Because `project_aliases` only grows, `unbound-alias` rarely fires, so a reused folder inherits the old project's level. ADR 0025 states this limit.

Advisory, debt (outside the change). `asString` and the existing per-key rules accept embedded newlines, and `renderEnvFile` writes values raw. The upheld defect above is this debt's consequence inside the change.

Upheld, defect (Q1/Q7). In the dock's segmented control the third label is cut to 'Knowledge …' by `truncate` at the dock's 320px. The selected widest level cannot be read without hovering. Seen in review/ui/projects-dock-success@1512.png and projects-dock-default@1512.png, both listed in review/ui/manifest.json, the manual path's manifest, since no review/ui-evidence.json exists. The manifest's observation 1 says the same.

Upheld, defect (Q5, a raw error shown to the user). The toast 'Sharing not saved' shows 'EACCES: permission denied, open ...' with the full data-directory path. Seen in review/ui/settings-sharing-error@1512.png, listed in review/ui/manifest.json. The same raw `error.message` pattern is at Sharing.vue:174 and ProjectsView.vue:138/150 (diff lines). The spec's wording also needs a plain sentence.

Upheld, defect (Q2, undeclared reachable branches; a gap in the spec). The diff adds five reachable branches that spec.md:279's state list does not declare and that review/ui/manifest.json neither declares nor captures: the problems alert (Sharing.vue:176), the load-error paragraph (:174), the inert-area row with Remove (:191-194), the dock's 'Not changed' toast (ProjectsView.vue:138/150), and the row pill at 'Knowledge' (ProjectsView.vue:220). These are diff lines no capture shows, for the reason that none was taken.

Advisory, from the reviewer's Not answerable. The declared states 'loading' and 'saving' of settings-sharing have no capture (review/ui/manifest.json `notCaptured`: transient, under a second). The manual manifest has no `summary.missing` and no capture spec, and the rubric names a loading state missing under a second as advisory. So this is recorded, not upheld as a defect. The e2e gate, which would capture them, is unavailable and awaits the person's decision.
Advisory, as filed. The root figure ('would leave') and the area figure ('entries in the area') read as the same measure (settings-sharing-default@1512.png, settings-sharing-locked@1512.png).
Advisory, as filed. The last-change line shows raw env tokens ('none → workspace:sales') (settings-sharing-success@1512.png).
Advisory, as filed. The level pill sits in the LINKS cell in the 'Uses' tone, so it reads as a link (projects-dock-success@1512.png).
Advisory, as filed. Save is enabled with nothing changed and reports 'Sharing saved' (settings-sharing-default@1512.png).
Advisory, debt (outside the change). The existing 'No links yet…' hint is unchanged text.

Lowered to advisory, as debt. The probe probes/restore-journal-mode.md answers the reviewer's 'one thing to confirm'. A `VACUUM INTO` copy is already in rollback-journal mode before the item's `PRAGMA journal_mode = DELETE`, and a restore without this item also leaves the store in that mode under `openDb`. The consequence is real but predates the item, and the item's line changes nothing about it. The fix belongs to src/store/db.ts: turn WAL on whenever the file is not in WAL mode. Recommended as its own item.

Advisory, as filed. `GET /api/sharing` refreshes every repository in turn in the viewer's process, with no overall budget. Failures are logged and recover, and the spec states that the cost grows with the person's choices.
Advisory, debt (outside the change). WAL is turned on only at creation, and doctor never reports the journal mode.
Advisory, debt (outside the change). `readEnvFile` turns a read error into an empty map. The new audit relies on it and fails closed.

Upheld, defect (Q2/Q3). ADR 0025:122 and the function's own docstring say a project entry's uid uses the bound alias 'also after the project lost it'. `entryAliases` reads that alias only from the live `sharing_levels` row. `reconcileLevels` (src/sharing/store.ts:373) and `setLevel(..., 'local')` (:323) delete that row, which I read in the tree. The uid then falls back to `MIN(remote alias)` or the empty alias, and `decide` answers `keep` where the ADR promises a withdrawal. Keep the binding apart from the level row, or state the limit and part 6's duty in ADR 0025.

Upheld, defect (Q1, a boundary crossed). `readEntries`, and `areaTotals` at :274, read `knowledge_entries`/`knowledge_repos` with raw SQL guarded only by `tableExists`. CLAUDE.md states that `requireSchema` is what 'everything that reads or writes the tables calls', and ADR 0020 K3 says modules own their tables. Only the `fresh: true` path reaches `requireSchema`. Check the knowledge schema state before reading.

Lowered to advisory (Q6). The project's `Redacted` brand is the neighbours' convention at the judge edge. ADR 0025 (D-19, :124, :189) makes `redactForSend` a required step 'in the process that sends it' (part 6) and is silent on whether the payload types carry the brand. A neighbour-convention disagreement that crosses no boundary the base draws is advisory, and no text leaves in this part. Worth adopting before part 6 builds payloads.
Advisory, as filed. `LedgerRecord`, `Decision` and `Item` have no pinned key list, and the ADR pins only four types.
Advisory, as filed. `policyInForce` is written twice. Upheld as a defect under code-quality.

Advisory, as filed. The lead's fact resolves the reviewer's Not answerable: `taxonomyFor` existed at 52c8acb (src/modules/knowledge/repo.ts:712). So `areasOf` is a second reader written beside an existing one, which is this change's drift and not debt. It is kept at the reviewer's advisory, which I may not raise. Reuse the module's reader or name it in CLAUDE.md.
Advisory, as filed. The settings line still says 'the environment wins' without the two sharing keys' exception.
Advisory, as filed. `SetLevelInput.source` accepts more than `viewer | cli`.
Advisory, as filed. `sharingReason: string` should import `Reason`.
Advisory, as filed. `resetSharingInCopy` does not check the copy's recorded sharing schema version before writing its tables.
Advisory, as filed. `ledgerRecords` scans `sharing_ledger` by design (ADR 0025's one grouped scan). The ledger is empty in this part. Parts 5 and 6 should check the query plan.

Advisory, as filed. The new per-project lookups scan `project_aliases`, which has no `project_id` index. The table is small. The reviewer did not raise this to a defect under the rubric's 'a new query beside it that scans the same table', and I do not raise it.
Advisory, as filed. Nothing reads the `sharing_changes_at` index, and `sharing_changes` has no stated retention. It holds no personal data.
Advisory, as filed. `resetLevels` leaves the copy's ledger as it is. Reconciling it is part 6's duty under ADR 0025 §Restore, and no ledger rows are written in this part.
Advisory, debt (outside the change). `project_aliases` has no index on `project_id`.
